llm.summary: This skill is not overtly malicious, but it asks for broad local tool access while its local-vs-API behavior is unclear.

dimensions.detail: Read, write, and command execution can be proportionate for local model automation, but the skill does not set clear boundaries for filesystem changes, command side effects, network/API use, or sensitive-data handling.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact is a single SKILL.md file with no bundled executable scripts, install hooks, or hidden secondary files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger language covers generic AI model calls, intelligent chat, agent orchestration, and LLM applications, which is broader than an Ollama-specific integration and could route unrelated tasks into a skill with read, write, and exec authority.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background worker or persistence mechanism is implemented in the artifact, though the paid-feature table references scheduling and event-driven operation as a paid capability.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is local Ollama integration, but the artifact also requires an API key and describes API/SDK/network integrations without clearly explaining whether prompts or data stay local.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing. Use it only if you are comfortable granting read, write, and command execution access for Ollama-related automation, and avoid sending sensitive prompts or files until the publisher clarifies whether any data is sent to external APIs and what the API key is for.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: the artifact starts as a local Ollama integration but expands into general API/SDK/network integration without a clear data-flow model.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: the artifact simultaneously says an API key is required and that it runs locally, leaving the security model ambiguous.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: the invocation guidance is broader than Ollama-specific use and could apply to unrelated AI or agent-orchestration requests.
[SQP-2] expected: Partly accepted: command execution and file handling can fit an automation skill, but the artifact does not clearly define user controls or limits for those capabilities.
